journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: Look at the number 45. The digit 4 is in the tens place and the digit 5 is in the ones place. We read it as 'forty-five'.
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about writing numbers 1 to 10 in words. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
